description: This file defines the class ClientControllerImpl, which implements the google::protobuf::RpcController interface for managing RPC calls within the Rialto IPC client. It includes method declarations for controlling and querying RPC call states, as well as handling failures and cancellations.

classes.name: ClientControllerImpl
classes.description: A final class implementing the google::protobuf::RpcController interface, managing RPC call states, failures, and cancellations for the Rialto IPC client.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the RPC controller to its initial state, allowing reuse for a new call.

methods.name: Failed
methods.description: Checks if the previous RPC call has failed.

methods.name: ErrorText
methods.description: Returns a string describing the error from the previous failed RPC call.

methods.name: StartCancel
methods.description: Starts the cancellation process for an ongoing RPC call.

methods.name: SetFailed
methods.description: Marks the RPC as failed with a given reason string.

methods.name: IsCanceled
methods.description: Checks if the RPC has been canceled by the client.

methods.name: NotifyOnCancel
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked if the RPC is canceled.

methods.name: setMethodCallFailed
methods.description: Sets the failure reason for the method call.

methods.name: setMethodCallFailed (overload)
methods.description: Sets the failure reason with a formatted message using printf-style arguments.
